blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image–label pairs to demonstrate input–output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task.
We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset.
The resulting pairing gap , defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees.
Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels.
To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing , replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode.
LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes.
It also mitigates these failure modes.
On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 0.733 to 0.857 0.857 while the gap shrinks from − 0.184 -0.184 to − 0.008 -0.008 .
In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap.
A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap.
This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.
blocks.zh:
视觉内文本学习(ICL)非常适合标签-稀缺医学成像,它使用支持图像-标签对来显示输入-输出映射,而标签则集体表示所请求的任务.
我们对单个配对的依赖性进行了诊断,测试时间错乱,在保存查询、支持图像和标签多集的同时,将每个支持标签重新分配给另一个支持图像。
由此得到的配对差距被定义为shuffled-minus-compared性能,这表明所有四个被放出的模式都依赖于配对,程度相差很大.
进一步分析一对训练有素的模型后发现,即使有真实的、不变的支持,也存在与支持有关的虚假地区和损害大小的偏见,同时对错误注册的支持标签具有敏感性。
为了规范这种依赖性,我们引入了后期不配乐课程(LUC),该课程从相匹配的训练开始,然后随机不配乐应用,将每个支持标签替换为同一集中另一个支持的标签.
LUC几乎缩小了两个主干线上的配对差距,同时保持或改进所有被评价任务类型的配对支持性能,收益扩展到被搁置的任务和跨数据集事件.
这也缓解了这些故障模式.
在BrATS全图图分化方面,配对的DSC从0.733 0.733上升到0.857 0.857,而差距从−0.184-0.184缩小到−0.008-0.08。
在所发布的模型中,用随机不平平来作短暂的微调可以缩小差距.
逆向课程在培训开始时将同样数目的不平日放出,留下了很大差距。
这表明,配对依赖是由培训顺序决定的,而不仅仅是未受培训的数量。

blocks.en:
In-context learning (ICL) lets a single model solve a new task from a few examples, with no task-specific retraining ( Brown et al., 2020 ) .
In its visual form the model receives a query image and a few support (image, label) pairs and returns a dense prediction, such as a segmentation or an image in another modality ( Bar et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2023b ; Kim et al., 2023 ) .
This suits medical imaging, where dense labels are scarce and expensive, and medical ICL models now cover 2D and 3D segmentation and image-to-image tasks ( Butoi et al., 2023 ; Czolbe and Dalca, 2023 ; Rakic et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
In-context学习(ICL)让单一模式从几个例子中解决了一个新任务,没有针对特定任务的再培训(Brown等,2020. ).
该模型的视觉形式得到查询图像和几对支持(图像,标签),并返回密集的预测,如用另一种模式进行分块或图像(Bar等,2022;Wang等,2023a; Wang等, 2023b; Kim等, 2023.).
这适合医疗成像,其中密集的标签稀缺而昂贵,医疗ICL模型现在覆盖了2D和3D分化和图像到图像的任务(Butoi等,2023;Czolbe和Dalca等,2023;Rakic等,2024;Hu等,2025;Hu等,2026).

blocks.en:
An underexplored question in ICL is how models use the supports to infer the task.
Support pairs provide task-relevant information in complementary ways.
A model can use the image–label correspondence within individual support pairs to infer how inputs map to outputs, while the collection of support labels can indicate what output is requested.
For example, support masks can collectively distinguish whole-tumor from edema segmentation, while their pairing with individual images provides example-specific mappings between image appearance and label.
Both sources can be informative, but how current visual ICL models balance them, and how strongly their predictions depend on individual image–label pairings, remains poorly understood.
blocks.zh:
ICL中一个探讨不足的问题是模型如何利用支持来推断任务.
支助对口以互补方式提供与任务有关的信息。
一个模型可以使用图像–在单个支持对中的标签对应来推断输入映射对输出的方式,而支持标签的收集可以显示请求输出的内容.
例如,支持口罩可以集体区分全图和水肿分解,而它们与单个图像的配对则提供了图像外观和标签之间的特有映射.
这两个来源都能够提供信息,但目前的视觉ICL模型如何平衡它们,以及它们的预测在多大程度上依赖于单个图像 — 标签配对,仍然不甚了解.

blocks.en:
We study this behavior through a test-time derangement that selectively disrupts individual image–label correspondence.
Specifically, we preserve the query image, all support images, and the same set of support labels, but reassign each label to a different support image, which gives shuffled supports ( Figure 1 ).
Comparing performance under matched and shuffled supports yields a pairing gap, which quantifies a model’s dependence on individual support pairings while holding the contents of the support set fixed.
In doing so, we find substantial variation in pairing dependence across existing visual ICL models ( Table 1 ) and show that strong dependence can have undesirable consequences.
In medical image segmentation, for example, the predicted lesion extent and location can be influenced by the size and spatial position of lesions in the support labels ( Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们通过测试时间的错乱来研究这种行为,
具体来说,我们保存了查询图像,所有支持图像,以及同一套支持标签,但将每个标签重新指定为不同的支持图像,这给出了被洗涤后的支持(图1).
在匹配和被洗碎的支撑下进行比较的性能会产生一个配对缺口,从而量化了模型在固定支撑集内容的同时对单个支撑配对的依赖.
在这样做时,我们发现现有视像式ICL模型在配对依赖方面有很大差异(表1),并表明强烈依赖可能产生不良后果。
例如,在医学图像分解中,预测的损伤程度和位置会受损伤在辅助标签中大小和空间位置的影响(第4节)。

blocks.en:
Building on this diagnostic, we find that training-time random unpairing can regulate how models use support pairing.
Replacing support labels during training with those of other supports in the same episode weakens the reliability of individual image–label correspondence, while the labels, taken together, still indicate which output is requested.
The timing of this intervention matters: a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which unpairs only after an initial period of conventional paired training, substantially reduces test-time pairing dependence.
This robustness comes without a trade-off in standard predictive performance: LUC maintains or improves performance under correctly matched supports across all evaluated task types.
It also mitigates several failure modes associated with excessive dependence on individual support pairs.
Together, the test-time derangement and training-time unpairing form a strategy for diagnosing and controlling pairing dependence in visual ICL: the former reveals how a trained model uses support correspondence, and the latter reshapes that behavior without changing the model architecture or giving up matched-support performance.
blocks.zh:
基于这种诊断,我们发现培训时间随机不配对可以调节模型如何使用支持配对.
将培训期间的支持标签与同一集中其他支持的标签相取代,削弱了个人图像-标签通信的可靠性,而标签组合起来,仍然表示请求的是哪个输出.
这种干预的时间安排很重要:迟到的不配对课程(LUC),只有经过最初的常规配对培训后才不配对,大大减少了测试时间配对的依赖性.
这种稳健性在标准预测性能上没有取舍: LUC 在所有评价任务类型中,在正确匹配支持下保持或改进性能.
这也缓解了与过度依赖个人支撑对相关的几种失败模式.
测试-时间的错乱与训练-时间的不平整共同构成了在视觉ICL中诊断和控制配对依赖的策略:前者揭示了训练有素的模型如何使用支持通信,而后者则在不改变模型架构或放弃匹配支持性能的情况下重塑了这一行为.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
In-context learning lets a model solve a task from a few input–output examples placed in its input ( Brown et al., 2020 ) .
In language models, how much the example labels matter depends on the setting: random labels barely lower accuracy on classification tasks ( Min et al., 2022 ) , while larger models follow flipped labels ( Wei et al., 2023 ) and ICL does learn the label relationships in its context ( Kossen et al., 2024 ) .
Recognizing which task the examples name can be separated from learning the task in context ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , transformers can solve ICL by copying from matching context ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) , and the training data decide whether ICL emerges and whether it persists ( Chan et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) .
We study pairing dependence in visual ICL and how it changes when support labels are reassigned during training.

校对:Soup
在语言模型中,示例标签在多大程度上取决于设置:随机标签在分类任务上几乎没有降低准确度(Min等,2022年),而较大的模型遵循倒转标签(Wei等,2023年),而ICL确实在其上下文中学习了标签关系(Kossen等,2024年).
确认实例名称与学习背景任务可以分离(Pan等,2023年),变压器可以通过从匹配上下文复制来解决ICL(Olsson等,2022年),培训数据则决定ICL是否出现以及是否持续(Chan等,2022年;Singh等,2023年).
我们研究视觉ICL中的配对依赖性,以及在训练期间重新分配支持标签时如何改变.

blocks.en:
Visual ICL defines a dense prediction task through a few (image, label) examples, first by inpainting a canvas that holds the examples and the query ( Bar et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023a ) and then at scale and for segmentation and other dense tasks ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023b ; Kim et al., 2023 ) .
Segment Anything ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) can also be adapted to segment a target from one reference image and its mask ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , and which examples are shown changes the result ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
In medical imaging, where labels are scarce, few-shot segmentation ( Ouyang et al., 2020 ) has grown into ICL models that solve unseen tasks from a support set without retraining: UniverSeg and Tyche in 2D ( Butoi et al., 2023 ; Rakic et al., 2024 ) , and Neuralizer, Neuroverse3D, Medverse and Iris for multi-task and 3D imaging ( Czolbe and Dalca, 2023 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) .
Universal models that take a spatial or text prompt instead of examples form a parallel line ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) .
Support labels are drawn by hand and vary within and between observers ( Karimi et al., 2020 ) , and in-context segmenters lose accuracy when their support labels are deformed ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) .
The ICL models are trained and evaluated with matched supports; we measure what four released models do when the pairing changes, and we change the pairing during training.

blocks.en:
Episodic training builds each step from a support set and a query ( Vinyals et al., 2016 ; Snell et al., 2017 ) .
When a query can be solved without its supports, a meta-learner can learn to ignore them, which a random assignment of labels per task prevents ( Yin et al., 2020 ; Rajendran et al., 2020 ) .
Random unpairing acts inside one support set and targets the opposite failure, excessive reliance on individual pairings: while it is applied, the labels still indicate the task as a set, but which image each label sits on carries no information.
blocks.zh:
Episodic培训从一个支持集和一个查询中建立每个步骤(Vinyals等,2016;Snell等,2017.).
当一个查询可以在没有支持的情况下被解决时,一个元取出者可以学会忽略它们,每个任务的标签随机指定可以防止(Yin等,2020;Rajendran等,2020.).
一个支持集内部的随机不配对行为,并针对相反的失败,过度依赖单个配对:在应用时,标签仍然将任务表示为一组,但每个标签所坐放的哪一个图像没有信息.

blocks.en:
Curriculum learning orders the training signal, classically from easy to hard examples ( Bengio et al., 2009 ) , and later work chooses the order automatically and studies when it helps ( Graves et al., 2017 ; Hacohen and Weinshall, 2019 ; Wu et al., 2021 ; Soviany et al., 2022 ) .
The order also shapes what a network keeps: deficits early in training can have lasting effects ( Achille et al., 2018 ) .
LUC orders how reliable the support pairs are rather than how hard the examples are, starting on matched supports and ending on unpaired ones; for the pairing gap we find the reverse of a lasting early effect, since the phase that ends training sets the gap.
blocks.zh:
课程学习命令训练信号,在经典上从简单的例子到硬的例子(Bengio等,2009年),后期工作会自动选择顺序,并在有所帮助时选择学习(Graves等,2017年;Hacohen和Weinshall,2019年;Wu等,2021年;Soviany等,2022年).
该顺序还塑造了网络保存的内容:早期培训的不足可以产生持久的效果(Achille等,2018年).
LUC命令支持对子的可靠性,而不是例子的难度,从匹配的对子支持开始,到未被保护的对子结束;对于对子差距,我们发现一个持久的早期效应的倒影,因为结束训练的阶段设置了差距.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We measure a model’s dependence on support pairings with a test-time derangement and then propose training-time random unpairing to regulate this dependence. Figure 2 shows both operations on a support set of four, and Appendix A gives the full protocol.
We describe the method in the context of Neuroverse3D ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , but the same formulation applies to all models tested here.

我们在Neuroverse3D(Hu等,2025年)的背景下描述了这种方法,但同一配方适用于在此测试的所有模型.

blocks.en:
We regulate pairing dependence in training with random unpairing.
In an unpairing epoch, every support in every episode has its label replaced by a copy of the label of another support in the same set, chosen at random; the query and its target are unchanged.
A label can therefore appear twice in the support set while another is dropped, so the training operator does not preserve the label multiset, while the test-time derangement does.
The operation is the same for every model we train; what differs is the schedule p ⁡ ( e ) p(e) , which marks each epoch e e as matched ( p ⁡ ( e ) = 0 p(e){=}0 ) or unpairing ( p ⁡ ( e ) = 1 p(e){=}1 ).
The late unpairing curriculum (LUC) keeps p ⁡ ( e ) = 0 p(e){=}0 for the first e 0 e_{0} epochs and sets p ⁡ ( e ) = 1 p(e){=}1 afterwards, so the model first learns from matched supports and then finishes training on unpaired ones.
We write LUC x , where x x is the fraction of training epochs with unpairing: LUC 0.5 unpairs in the second half of training, and LUC 0.2 only in the final fifth.
LUC 0.5 is our primary schedule, and LUC without a subscript refers to it when results are reported.
The early unpairing curriculum (EUC x ) runs the same schedule in reverse, unpairing first and ending on matched supports, and serves as a control for timing, since it unpairs for as many epochs as LUC x .
Two constant schedules complete the family: p ⁡ ( e ) = 0 p(e){=}0 throughout, which is conventional paired training, and p ⁡ ( e ) = 1 p(e){=}1 throughout, the unpaired model.
Every Neuroverse3D model we train uses one recipe, detailed in Appendix A , on a mix of five task types from BraTS and three T1 brain MRI cohorts: tumor segmentation, anatomical segmentation, modality translation, inpainting and bias correction.

blocks.en: 4 Pairing dependence and the failure modes of paired training
blocks.zh: 4 对等依赖和对等培训的失败模式

blocks.en:
Pairing gap of ICL models. The derangement is a black-box, inference-only test, so we apply it to four released models to derive their pairing gap ( Table 1 ; per-model protocols in Appendix A ).
On the two BraTS segmentation tasks ( Menze et al., 2014 ) , the four models differ substantially in how strongly they depend on the pairing.
On the whole-tumor segmentation task, the test-time derangement induces a DSC drop of at least 0.11 0.11 (for Neuroverse3D), with the largest drop, 0.63 0.63 , observed for the general-purpose SegGPT.
For the edema segmentation task, the pairing gap ranges from − 0.35 -0.35 to − 0.51 -0.51 .
The gap also differs between tasks for the same model; Neuroverse3D, for example, has a gap of − 0.11 -0.11 on whole-tumor segmentation and − 0.35 -0.35 on edema segmentation.

在两个BRATS分化任务(Menze等,2014年)上,四个模型在对配对的依赖程度上有很大的不同.
在全图克分解任务上,试验-时间分解会诱发至少0.11 0.11的DSC下降(对于神经元3D),最大下降为0.63 0.63,观测到通用SegGPT.
对于水肿分解任务,配对差距从−0.35-0.35到−0.51-0.51.
同一型号的任务间的差距也不同;例如,Neurorverse3D在整分层上的差距为−0.11-0.11;水肿分层上的差距为−0.35-0.35.

blocks.en:
Support-label properties influence query predictions. The pairing gap measures how much a prediction depends on which label sits on which image; it does not show what this dependence does to the prediction.
Under matched supports, each support label is the correct answer for its own image, so a model can take parts of its answer, such as where the tumor lies and how large it is, from the support labels instead of from the query.
We examine whether such support-specific properties carry over to the query prediction in the Neuroverse3D model trained with matched supports only ( p = 0 p{=}0 ), the paired model .
Using 60 60 BraTS validation subjects with K = 4 K{=}4 supports, we first inspect this behavior with real, unaltered support sets and then test it directly through controlled perturbations of the support labels ( Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh:
支持标签属性影响查询预测. 配对差距测量一个预测取决于哪个标签是哪个图像;它没有显示这种依赖对预测的作用.
在匹配后的支持下,每个支持标签都是自己图像的正确答案,因此一个模型可以取出部分答案,比如肿瘤的位置和大小,从支持标签而不是从查询中取出.
我们研究这种支持特定属性是否延续到仅经过匹配支持(p=0 p{=}0)训练的Neuroverse3D模型中的查询预测,配对模型.
使用有K = 4 KQQ4支持的60个 BratS 验证主体,我们首先用真实的,没有改变的支持集来检查这种行为,然后通过对支持标签的控制扰动直接测试(图3).

blocks.en:
With real, unaltered support sets, we observe that the model tends to segment regions that are absent in the query image.
On average, the model generates 2.40 2.40 such extra regions per case ( Figure 3 a).
These regions are not randomly distributed: they tend to lie where the support labels carry tumor, and simply deleting these extra regions from the segmentation would raise the DSC by 0.041 0.041 , which indicates that the support-associated behavior accounts for a measurable fraction of the model’s error.
Moreover, we observe that the predicted tumor size also follows the support labels: after accounting for the true tumor volume, larger support labels are associated with larger predicted tumor volumes ( Figure 3 b). Appendix C gives details on counting the extra regions and on the volume analysis.
blocks.zh:
有了真实的,没有变化的支持集,我们观察到模型倾向于分解查询图像中缺失的区域.
该模型平均每例产生2.40个此类额外区域(图3a)。
这些区域不是随机分布的:它们往往位于支持标签携带肿瘤的地方,简单地从分块中去掉这些额外的区域会将DSC提升0.041 0.041,这表明支持相关行为占模型误差的可测量分量.
此外,我们还注意到,预测的肿瘤大小也跟随支持标签:在计算出真实的肿瘤体积后,较大的支持标签与预测的肿瘤体积较大相关(图3b). 附 录 C详细介绍了额外区域的计算和数量分析。

blocks.en:
Controlled perturbations of support-label properties. Given the above evidence, we next causally test whether properties of the support labels influence the query prediction. We perturb the support labels while leaving the query and support images unchanged, using two interventions.
First, we shift every support label by 8 8 voxels along each of two axes, as a mis-registration would.
The model’s predicted tumor centroid moves 0.67 0.67 voxels along the shift ( Figure 3 c). This perturbation also reduces whole-tumor DSC by 0.035 0.035 ( Figure 10 in Appendix D shows this cost next to replaced and eroded support labels), showing that the transferred spatial bias has a measurable effect on segmentation accuracy.
Next, we inject one synthetic mask into every support label, at a place where the query has no tumor. This intervention makes the model predict most of the injected region as tumor: the fraction of mask voxels predicted as tumor rises by 0.846 0.846 ( Figure 8 in Appendix C shows an example).
In every one of these tests, the prediction of the model follows the support labels rather than the query.

该模型预测的肿瘤中间体会沿移位移动0.67 0.67伏克赛尔(图3 c. 这种扰动还使全图解DSC减少0.035 0.035 (附录D中图10显示在被替换和被侵蚀后的支持标签旁边的这一成本),表明所转移的空间偏差对分化精度有可测量的影响.
接下来,我们将一个合成口罩注入每一个支持标签, 在一个查询没有肿瘤的地方。 这种干预使得模型预测出大部分被注射区域为肿瘤:随着肿瘤上升而预测的口罩花瓶分量会上升0.846 0.846 (附录C中图8显示了一个例子).

blocks.en: 5 LUC reduces the dependence and the failure modes
blocks.zh: 5 LUC 减少依赖和失败模式

blocks.en:
Paired training gives a model no reason to doubt a single support label, because every support label belongs to its own image.
We want a model that still learns the task from its supports but no longer takes its answer from individual support labels.
Random unpairing ( Section 3 ) supplies that reason: once each support carries another support’s label, a single label is no longer a reliable answer, while the labels as a set still show which output is requested.
LUC applies it late, after a phase of matched training in which the model learns from correct pairs how images map to labels.
blocks.zh:
Paired trainment给予一个模型,没有理由怀疑一个单一的支持标签,因为每一个支持标签都属于自己的图像.
我们希望有一个模式,它仍然从其支持中汲取任务,但不再从个人支持标签中吸取答案。
随机解码 (第3节)提供这个理由:一旦每个支持带有另一个支持的标签,一个单一的标签就不再是可靠的答案,而作为集的标签仍然显示请求的输出.
LUC应用很晚,经过一个相匹配的训练阶段,模型从正确的对子学习图像映射到标签的方式.

blocks.en: 5.1 Pairing gap and matched-support performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 对等差距和匹配支助业绩

blocks.en:
LUC closes the pairing gap. Under the test-time derangement, LUC predictions barely depend on which label sits on which support image.
On the BraTS whole-tumor segmentation task, the gap shrinks from − 0.184 -0.184 for the paired model to − 0.008 -0.008 for LUC 0.5 ( Figure 4 ), and on all five trained task types it is near zero for both LUC models ( Table 2 ).
The reduction extends beyond BraTS and beyond one backbone.
On three anatomical cohorts spanning children in ABCD ( Casey et al., 2018 ) , older adults in ADNI ( Jack Jr et al., 2008 ) and a mixed population in OASIS-3 ( LaMontagne et al., 2019 ) , LUC 0.5 leaves a gap within 0.004 0.004 DSC of zero ( Table 7 in Appendix D gives the gap for each cohort). When applied to 2D UniverSeg trained from scratch on BraTS multi-region segmentation,
LUC reduces the gap from − 0.222 -0.222 to about zero ( Table 8 in Appendix D compares the two backbones).

削减范围超越了BRATS,超出了一个骨干.

LUC improves matched-support performance. Importantly, the reduction in pairing dependence is not achieved by trading off performance under correctly paired supports; LUC instead improves matched-support performance. Across all five trained task types, LUC maintains or improves matched-support performance relative to the paired model ( Table 2 ).
On the primary whole-tumor segmentation task, LUC 0.5 increases the matched-support DSC from 0.733 0.733 to 0.857 0.857 (subject-level Wilcoxon p = 2.4 × 10 − 5 p{=}2.4{\times}10^{-5} ).
The improvement also extends across populations, with DSC on ADNI increasing from 0.466 0.466 to 0.737 0.737 , and UniverSeg keeps its matched-support DSC.

blocks.en:
The gain also holds outside the training distribution.
Held-out tasks change the segmentation target, the translation direction or the inpainting setting to ones that never occur in training, and cross-dataset episodes take the supports and the query from different datasets, as when a support set was collected on another scanner or population, whereas every training episode draws both from one dataset.
On 46 46 of 53 53 such tasks, both LUC models have a significantly higher matched-support score than the paired model, with near-zero gaps. Figure 5 shows 25 25 of these tasks, and Table 10 in Appendix G lists all 53 53 .
Notably, for a held-out bias-correction task with a coarser bias field than those seen during training, the paired model barely corrects the input while both LUC models do ( Figure 5 c).
blocks.zh:
收益还保留在培训分配之外。
被搁置的任务将分区目标,翻译方向或插图设置更改为训练中从未发生的,跨数据集事件从不同的数据集取取来支持和查询,如在另一台扫描机或人群上收集到支持集,而每集培训都取自一个数据集.
在53个53个这样的任务中的46个46个中,两个LUC模型的配对支持分数都比配对模型高得多,差距接近于零. 图5显示其中25项任务,附录G表10列出所有53项。
值得注意的是,对于一个与培训期间所见相比有相近偏差字段的被搁置的偏差校正任务,配对模型几乎无法校正输入,而两个LUC模型都做了(图5c)。

blocks.en:
The timing of unpaired training matters. Unpairing in every epoch does not enjoy the same combination of low pairing dependence and high matched-support performance as LUC: the unpaired model reaches a matched-support DSC of only 0.611 0.611 , against 0.733 0.733 for the paired model ( Figure 4 ).
On the other hand, EUC (trained on unpaired supports first and matched supports last) cannot fully close the gap; e.g., EUC 0.5 and EUC 0.2 keep whole-tumor gaps of − 0.091 -0.091 and − 0.130 -0.130 ( Figure 4 ).
The gap logged at every training epoch ( Figure 6 ) shows that LUC 0.5 reduces the pairing gap within a few epochs after switching to unpaired supports on all five tasks tracked during training, whereas both EUC models regain their gap once training returns to matched supports.
A short final phase of unpairing is therefore enough, and it adds no parameters, training steps, labels or inference cost.
blocks.zh:
未经批准的培训时间很重要。 在每个时代中不配对并不像LUC那样享受低配对依赖和高配对支持性能的组合:无配对模型只达到0.611 0.611的配对支持DSC,而配对模型为0.733 0.733 (图4).
另一方面,EUC(先在未发证支持上培训,再在最后配对支持上培训)不能完全弥合差距;例如,EUC 0.5和EUC 0.2保持了-0.091-0.091和-0.130的全震相差(图4).
在每个培训时代记录的差距(图6)表明,LUC 0.5在培训期间跟踪的所有五个任务中转换为未授奖支持后,在几个时代中减少了配对差距,而欧统会的两个模式在培训恢复匹配支持后重新获得差距。
因此,短暂的最后阶段的不补偿就足够了,它没有增加参数、培训步骤、标签或推论费用。

Therefore, for a released model the matched phase has already been run by its authors, so a short phase of random unpairing on top of it completes an LUC schedule.
We test this by fine-tuning the released Neuroverse3D on our data mix with random unpairing. As a control, we separately fine-tune the model with matched supports for the same number of steps ( Figure 7 ).
After 1000 1000 steps of fine-tuning, a small fraction of one training run of our recipe, the gap for edema segmentation shrinks from − 0.353 -0.353 to − 0.036 -0.036 and stays near zero, while the control keeps a large gap; matched-support DSC rises in both arms ( Appendix D gives the values over the whole fine-tuning run).

blocks.en: 5.2 LUC reduces failure modes
blocks.zh: 5.2 LUC 减少故障模式

blocks.en:
LUC 0.5 reduces each failure mode of Section 4 , and Figure 3 compares LUC 0.5 and the paired model on the same cases and supports.
With real support sets, LUC 0.5 adds fewer regions that the query does not have ( 0.62 0.62 per case against 2.40 2.40 ).
Removing these extra regions hardly impacts the DSC of LUC 0.5 ( 0.007 0.007 , against 0.041 0.041 for the paired model).
Moreover, with LUC 0.5 the predicted tumor size hardly follows the tumor size in the support labels.
Under the controlled perturbations, shifting the support labels barely moves its prediction ( 0.25 0.25 voxels for LUC 0.5 against 0.67 0.67 for the paired model), and the shift also costs LUC 0.5 only 0.001 0.001 DSC, against 0.035 0.035 for the paired model.
Lastly, an injected mask raises the predicted fraction of the mask by only 0.095 0.095 , against 0.846 0.846 for the paired model ( Appendix F gives the other models).
The timing of the unpairing matters here too: EUC 0.5 , which ends on matched supports, still predicts most of the injected mask ( 0.817 0.817 ; Figure 11 in Appendix E ).
Support-specific properties thus carry over far less to the query predictions of LUC 0.5 .

有了真正的支持,LUC 0.5增加了查询没有的区域(每起案件0.62起,2.40起为2.40起)。
消除这些额外的区域几乎不会影响LUC 0.5(0.007 0.007.)的DSC,而配对型号为0.041 0.041.
此外,在LUC 0.5的情况下,预测的肿瘤大小几乎跟不上辅助标签中的肿瘤大小。
在受控扰动下,转动支持标签几乎不会移动它的预测(LUC 0.5的0.25 voxels对对配对模型的0.67 0.67),而转动还花费了LUC 0.5只0.001 DSC,对配对模型的0.035 0.035.

这里的不配角事项的时机: EUC 0.5结束于匹配的后缀上,仍然预测大部分被注射的口罩(0.817 0.817;附录E中图11).
因此,支持性特定属性远少于LUC 0.5的查询预测。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Any in-context learner that conditions on a set of examples ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2023b ) draws on two sources of information: the correspondence within each example, and the examples as a set.
Deranging the support labels disrupts the first and holds the second fixed, and in the paired model it costs more DSC than replacing the labels with other patients’ labels, which also changes which labels the set contains ( Appendix B ).
The derangement needs no new labels or held-out split and runs on a released model as it is.
Pairing dependence appears in all four released models, across 2D and 3D, four ways of fusing the supports and a general-purpose model, and its strength differs between models and tasks ( Table 1 ), so the derangement can be added to the evaluation of any visual ICL model.
blocks.zh:
任何以一组实例作为条件的内文学习者(Brown等,2020;Wang等,2023b.)都取自两个信息来源:每个实例内部的对应,以及作为一组的示例.
分解支持标签会扰乱第一个并持有第二个固定,在配对模型中,比用其他患者的标签来取而代之更需要DSC,这也改变了套装的标签(附录B).
神经错乱不需要新的标签或被搁置的分出,运行在所释放的模型上。
配对依赖出现在所有4个被放出模型中,跨越了2D和3D,4个相接支持和通用模型的相接方式,其强度也因模型和任务而异(表1),因此可以将离心功能添加到任何视觉ICL模型的评价中.

blocks.en:
Under matched supports every label is correct for its own image, so relying on the pairing works throughout paired training.
The dependence follows the current phase of training: the gap closes within a few epochs of a switch to unpaired supports and comes back at a similar rate once training returns to matched supports ( Figure 6 ).
As in curriculum learning ( Bengio et al., 2009 ) , the order of training matters, and for the gap it matters more than the amount of unpairing: LUC 0.2 , which unpairs only in the final fifth, has a gap near zero, while EUC 0.5 , which unpairs for the whole first half, keeps a gap ( Figure 4 ).
A practitioner therefore sets the dependence by choosing when unpairing starts, and a released model needs only a short final phase of unpairing ( Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh:
在配对支持下,每个标签对自己的形象都是正确的,因此依赖于配对工作的整个配对训练.
依赖性遵循培训的目前阶段:差距在切换到未授受支持的几个时期内被缩小,一旦培训恢复到匹配支持的水平,就会以类似的速度返回(图6)。
与课程学习(Bengio等,2009年)一样,培训的顺序很重要,对于差距,它比不补偿的数量更重要:LUC 0.2,它只在最后的第五阶段不补偿,差距接近于零,而整个上半期不补偿的EUC 0.5保持了差距(图4).
因此,从业者通过选择何时开始不付费来设定依赖性,发布的模型只需要一个短暂的不付费的最后阶段(图7).

blocks.en:
Support labels in medical in-context learning are few and drawn by hand ( Karimi et al., 2020 ) , and a label can end up out of register with its scan.
In the paired model, mis-registered support labels move the prediction and lower its accuracy ( Section 4 ).
LUC reduces reliance on individual support labels while maintaining or improving matched-support performance: the same shift barely moves its prediction and costs almost no accuracy ( Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
医疗内文学习中的支持标签很少,而且用手取出(Karimi等,2020年),一个标签通过扫描可以最终出局.
在配对模型中,错误注册的支持标签会移动预测并降低其准确性(第4节.
LUC在保持或改进匹配支持性能的同时,减少对单个支持标签的依赖:同样的转变几乎不会移动其预测,成本几乎没有准确性(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Visual in-context learners infer a task from support pairs, and we asked how strongly their predictions depend on the individual image–label pairings.
Deranging the support labels at test time leaves the label multiset unchanged and moves only the pairing, and the resulting pairing gap shows that this dependence varies widely across four released models.
The late unpairing curriculum, random unpairing scheduled late in training, substantially reduces the dependence and the failure modes of paired training while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, and a short unpairing phase shrinks the gap of a released model.
The reduction in the gap holds across three populations, on held-out tasks and on cross-dataset episodes.
With the same number of unpairing epochs, the schedule that ends on unpaired supports has the gap closer to zero, so the phase that ends training sets how much the prediction depends on the pairing.
The derangement diagnoses pairing dependence, and the schedule p ⁡ ( e ) p(e) controls it.
blocks.zh:
视觉内文本学习者从支持对子中推断出一个任务,我们问到他们的预测在多大程度上依赖于单个图像-标签对等.
在测试时间对支持标签进行分解,使标签多集不变,只移动配对,由此产生的配对缺口表明,这种依赖性在四个被放出模型中差异很大.
迟到的不补偿课程,在培训后期随机安排的不补偿课程,大大减少了对等培训的依赖性和失败模式,同时保持或改进所有被评价任务类型的匹配支持性能,一个短暂的不补偿阶段会缩小所释放模式的差距.
差距的缩小涉及三个群体,即被搁置的任务和跨数据集事件。
以同样多的不平分时代,以未平分支持结束的进度表使得差距更接近于零,因此结束训练的相位设定了预测取决于配对的程度.
神经错乱诊断成对的依赖性,以及调度p ⁡ (e) p (e) 控制它.

blocks.en: Data and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 数据和预处理

blocks.en:
Training uses BraTS 2021 ( Menze et al., 2014 ; Bakas et al., 2017 ; Baid et al., 2021 ) , with co-registered T1, T1ce, T2 and FLAIR images and nested ET/TC/WT labels, together with three T1 datasets, ABCD ( Casey et al., 2018 ) , ADNI ( Jack Jr et al., 2008 ) and OASIS-3 ( LaMontagne et al., 2019 ) , which carry SynthSeg anatomical labels ( Billot et al., 2023 ) .
Preprocessing clips intensities to the [ 0.5 % , 99.5 % ] [0.5\%,99.5\%] percentiles, applies z-score normalization, then crops, pads and resizes each volume to 128 3 128^{3} ; images receive a final min–max normalization.
Labels use the crop coordinates of their images, so every support image and its label share one spatial frame, and labels are never intensity-normalized.
We use a 90 / 10 90/10 train/validation split per dataset, and all reported numbers are computed on held-out validation subjects.
Whole-tumor labels follow the BraTS convention ( Menze et al., 2014 ) .

blocks.en: Subject-level evaluation
blocks.zh: 专题评价

blocks.en:
Metrics are aggregated to one value per subject before any test, so no subject contributes more than once.
Unless stated otherwise, confidence intervals use a subject-level bootstrap with 5,000 5{,}000 resamples; the support-volume regression of Section 4 uses 10,000 10{,}000 resamples of the queries.
Within-subject comparisons (matched against shuffled supports, or one model against another) use the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control within each task family.
The multi-dataset evaluation uses n = 30 n{=}30 subjects for segmentation, n = 20 n{=}20 for translation and n = 12 n{=}12 for anatomical segmentation; the failure-mode analysis uses n = 60 n{=}60 , and each probe states its own sample size.
The pairing gap is a within-model, within-subject contrast, so each model is compared with itself.

blocks.en: We evaluate the multi-task models under matched, cross-patient, zeroed, Gaussian-noise and shuffled support labels ( K = 4 K{=}4 , n = 30 n{=}30 ; Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价匹配、交叉病人、零化、高斯噪声和洗牌支持标签下的多任务模型(K=4 K{=}4,n=30 n{=}30;表5)。

blocks.en:
The contrast that matters is shuffled against zeroed.
With shuffled supports, each support of the paired model ( p = 0 p{=}0 ) carries another support’s label from the same support set.
Every one of those labels is real and correct for some image in the set.
Moving the labels this way costs more than zeroing them: 0.549 0.549 shuffled < 0.655 <0.655 zeroed < 0.661 <0.661 cross-patient < 0.733 <0.733 matched.
A model sensitive to any change in the labels would lose at least as much when the labels are zeroed as when they are moved among real images.
The measured order is the reverse, which places the loss in the assignment.
Gaussian-noise labels, which destroy the label content, score lower still ( 0.461 0.461 ).
We therefore read pairing specificity from the ordering against the zeroed and the cross-patient condition: the paired model depends on which label goes with which image.

衡量的顺序是倒数,将损失置于转让中。
高斯-噪声标签破坏标签内容,得分更低(0.461 0.461 ).

blocks.en: A real-support example and the injected-mask test
blocks.zh: 真实支持的示例和注入任务测试

blocks.en:
The effect appears with real supports and no manipulation ( Figure 8 , top).
On a query whose ground truth is a single tumor, the paired model predicts two disconnected regions.
It places one of them where the supports carry tumor and the query does not, while LUC 0.5 predicts only the real region.
This over-segmentation is systematic: across single-tumor queries the paired model adds a spurious disconnected region in 71 % 71\% of cases, against 38 % 38\% for LUC 0.5 .
We then paint a fixed synthetic mask into all K K support labels at a location outside the query’s tumor, so the only change to the input is that mask ( Figure 8 , middle; definition in Appendix A ).
The paired model reproduces the mask in its own prediction (injected-mask response + 0.846 +0.846 ), while the response of LUC 0.5 is + 0.095 +0.095 . Appendix F gives the response across the family.

它把其中之一放置在支持携带肿瘤而查询不进行的地方,而LUC 0.5只预测出真实的区域.
这种过于分化是系统性的:通过单图解查询,配对模式在71%的71%的病例中增加了一个虚假的断开区域,而LUC 0.5则增加了38%的38。
然后,我们将一个固定的合成口罩涂入所有K K 支持标签中,位于查询肿瘤以外的位置,所以输入的唯一变化就是这个口罩(图8,中;附录A中的定义).
配对模型在自己的预测中复制了口罩(注射-面具反应+0.846+0.846),而LUC 0.5的反应为+0.095+0.095. 附录. F给出了全家的响应.

blocks.en:
Table 7 splits the anatomical-segmentation result of Table 2 into its three cohorts.
On all three cohorts LUC 0.5 has a gap within 0.004 0.004 of zero and LUC 0.2 within 0.016 0.016 , and both have matched-support DSC above the paired model.

blocks.en: Qualitative multi-task comparison

blocks.en:
Figure 9 shows single cases behind the numbers.
The top block uses shuffled supports on two tasks.
On BraTS whole tumor the paired model returns a partial, displaced mask (DSC ∼ 0.6 {\sim}0.6 ), and on T2 → \to FLAIR synthesis it loses tissue detail, while LUC 0.5 and LUC 0.2 track the target.
EUC 0.5 and EUC 0.2 degrade along with the paired model, and the unpaired model sits between the two.
The bottom block uses matched supports and spans the trained task suite across all four datasets: whole-tumor segmentation, three modality-translation directions, anatomical segmentation (ADNI), inpainting (OASIS-3) and bias-field correction (ABCD).
Accuracy there is comparable across the models.
LUC 0.5 matches the paired model on translation and restoration and fills the inpainting box slightly better.
On the two segmentation tasks it drops the spurious whole-tumor region the paired model adds, and it recovers the atrophic ADNI ventricle the paired model under-segments.

The probes agree in direction.
The two LUC models, which end on unpaired supports after a matched phase, hold their DSC across the three support-label conditions and give the weakest injected-mask response.
The paired model and both EUC models, which end on matched supports, lose DSC when the labels move and reproduce the injected mask.
The two models of each mirror pair unpair for the same number of epochs and differ in when the unpairing is applied, so what separates them is what training ends on.
LUC 0.5 combines a small pairing gap and a weak injected-mask response with matched-support DSC 0.857 0.857 against 0.733 0.733 for the paired model.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the paired model and both LUC models on tasks that never occur in training, with the protocol of Appendix D : K = 4 K{=}4 supports fixed per dataset from its training split, queries from its validation split (40 for BraTS and IXI 1 1 1 https://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/ , 20 per T1 cohort), matched and shuffled supports, DSC for segmentation, and PSNR inside the target foreground or, for inpainting, inside the filled boxes.
One derangement is drawn per query and shared by all models.
Held-out tasks change the segmentation target, the translation direction, the inpainting setting or the bias-field grid, or apply inpainting to BraTS and IXI; the held-out segmentation targets span both hemispheres or several structures, while training used single structures.
Cross-dataset episodes take the supports from one dataset and the queries from another, which never happens in training. Table 10 lists 53 53 tasks, grouped by task type: the tasks on which all three models perform the task, with DSC of at least 0.6 0.6 or at least 1 1 dB above the unprocessed input, and at least one LUC model scores significantly above the paired model while neither scores significantly below it, together with three bias-correction tasks with a coarser 3 3 3^{3} control grid (on the T1 cohorts, BraTS → \to ABCD and ABCD → \to BraTS) on which the paired model stays within 0.2 0.2 dB of the input while both LUC models improve on it by 0.7 0.7 to 1.3 1.3 dB.
On 46 46 of the 53 53 tasks both LUC models score significantly above the paired model (subject-level Wilcoxon, p < 0.05 p{<}0.05 ); on the seven marked ones, one of them does and the other does not differ significantly from it.
On the 46 46 tasks, LUC 0.5 scores up to 0.128 0.128 DSC and 3.8 3.8 dB above the paired model, and its pairing gap averages − 0.004 -0.004 DSC and − 0.13 -0.13 dB, against − 0.054 -0.054 DSC and − 2.41 -2.41 dB for the paired model.
